'''Maun Digitalis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEGTW" /> located in the [[Maun Digitalis system/Legends|Maun Digitalis system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="NorthernDependencies" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the elite Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] fought on Maun Digitalis.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maun Digitalis was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Maun Digitalis [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world Maun Digitalis, in grid square L-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
